Definition
[elliptic operator]

Source: petersen:page-0420, petersen:page-0421 ↗ def:pet-ch11-holder-pseudonorm For $Lu=a^{ij}\partial _i\partial _ju+b^i\partial _iu$ with $a^{ij}=a^{ji}$, call $L$ elliptic when $(a^{ij})$ is positive definite. Assume eigenvalues of $(a^{ij})$ lie in $[\lambda ,\lambda ^{-1}]$, $\lambda >0$, and $\| a^{ij}\| _\alpha \le \lambda ^{-1}$, $\| b^i\| _\alpha \le \lambda ^{-1}$.
